description: Get the option chain (strikes, greeks, IV, open interest) for <symbol> expiring <expiration>. Returns every call and put at that expiration with bid/ask/last, volume, open interest, and greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega/IV). Example: tradier_option_chain({ symbol: "AAPL", expiration: "2026-01-16", _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: Tradier access token (free with a funded Tradier brokerage account, or a sandbox token)

expiration.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2026-01-16" (use tradier_option_expirations to list valid dates)

sandbox.description: Use the Tradier sandbox environment (sandbox.tradier.com) instead of production. Default false.

name: tradier_option_chain
title: Tradier Option Chain
